description: This file implements a server module for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in the Playwright project, including server creation, connection handling, heartbeat management, and HTTP transport setup.

classes.name: ServerBackend
classes.description: Interface defining backend methods for the MCP server, including optional initialization and server closure.

classes.name: ServerBackendFactory
classes.description: Type defining factory for creating server backends, including name, version, and creation method.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a server backend using a specified transport and optional heartbeat.

methods.name: wrapInProcess
methods.description: Wraps a backend in an in-process transport for local communication.

methods.name: createServer
methods.description: Creates and configures an MCP server instance with request handlers and event listeners.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server, either via direct connection or HTTP transport based on options.
